Review an original Verilog module against the supplied public role and
fixed-configuration behavior. Candidates can be healthy or contain a historical
defect; you receive no label, corrected RTL, maintainer patch or audit result.
Return decision=keep with edits=[] if no functional repair is needed, otherwise
decision=repair with up to 12 line-range replacements. Line numbers refer to the
ORIGINAL editable file, including blank lines; start_line/end_line are inclusive.
Replacements are complete line blocks; a missing final newline is appended by
the patch applicator. No functional change is made by the controller.
Preserve the exact license/interface prefix, public ports, parameter defaults,
compiler directives and module names. Do not edit dependencies. New plain reg
declarations and synthesizable constant initial assignments are allowed where
needed. No runtime system tasks/file reads, hierarchy, functions/tasks, new
clocking event forms, timing delays, assumptions/assertions, compiler pragmas,
input drivers or extra modules. Avoid unrelated refactors. Public historical
code can have appeared in model training; this is not an unseen benchmark.
Return only the JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "properties": {"decision": {"type": "string", "enum": ["keep", "repair"]}, "edits": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"start_line": {"type": "integer"}, "end_line": {"type": "integer"}, "replacement": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["start_line", "end_line", "replacement"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "explanation": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["decision", "edits", "explanation"], "additionalProperties": false}

Public contract:
{"module_role": "Frame FIFO. Reset flushes packet pointers and partial/drop state. Preserve ordering and end-of-frame metadata across stalls and repeated reset.", "top": "axis_frame_fifo", "clock": "clk", "ports": {"clk": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "drop_frame": {"direction": "output", "width": 1}, "input_axis_tdata": {"direction": "input", "width": 8}, "input_axis_tlast": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "input_axis_tready": {"direction": "output", "width": 1}, "input_axis_tuser": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "input_axis_tvalid": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "output_axis_tdata": {"direction": "output", "width": 8}, "output_axis_tlast": {"direction": "output", "width": 1}, "output_axis_tready": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "output_axis_tvalid": {"direction": "output", "width": 1}, "rst": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}}, "admission": "Match fixed-configuration cycle-exact public-port regression behavior. This is a trace oracle, not an unbounded property proof. Two additional audit input sequences are unavailable to the model.", "execution": "Native Verilator two-state simulation, unspecified initialization zero, explicit Verilog initial values retained", "editing": "Only edit the displayed original file; preserve ports, parameters, directives and license/header. Dependencies are read-only."}

32: module axis_frame_fifo #
33: (
34:     parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 2,
35:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
36:     parameter DROP_WHEN_FULL = 1
37: )
38: (
39:     input  wire                   clk,
40:     input  wire                   rst,
41:     
42:     
43: 
44: 
45:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  input_axis_tdata,
46:     input  wire                   input_axis_tvalid,
47:     output wire                   input_axis_tready,
48:     input  wire                   input_axis_tlast,
49:     input  wire                   input_axis_tuser,
50:     
51:     
52: 
53: 
54:     output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  output_axis_tdata,
55:     output wire                   output_axis_tvalid,
56:     input  wire                   output_axis_tready,
57:     output wire                   output_axis_tlast,
58:     output reg                    drop_frame
59: );
60: 
61: reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_ptr = {ADDR_WIDTH+1{1'b0}};
62: reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_ptr_cur = {ADDR_WIDTH+1{1'b0}};
63: reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_ptr = {ADDR_WIDTH+1{1'b0}};
64: 
65: 
66: 
67: reg [DATA_WIDTH+2-1:0] data_out_reg = {1'b0, {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}}};
68: 
69: 
70: reg [DATA_WIDTH+2-1:0] mem[(2**ADDR_WIDTH)-1:0];
71: 
72: reg output_read = 1'b0;
73: 
74: reg output_axis_tvalid_reg = 1'b0;
75: 
76: wire [DATA_WIDTH+2-1:0] data_in = {input_axis_tlast, input_axis_tdata};
77: 
78: 
79: wire full = ((wr_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH] != rd_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH]) &&
80:              (wr_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] == rd_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]));
81: 
82: wire empty = wr_ptr == rd_ptr;
83: 
84: wire full_cur = ((wr_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH] != wr_ptr_cur[ADDR_WIDTH]) &&
85:                  (wr_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] == wr_ptr_cur[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]));
86: 
87: wire write = input_axis_tvalid & (~full | DROP_WHEN_FULL);
88: wire read = (output_axis_tready | ~output_axis_tvalid_reg) & ~empty;
89: 
90: assign {output_axis_tlast, output_axis_tdata} = data_out_reg;
91: 
92: assign input_axis_tready = (~full | DROP_WHEN_FULL);
93: assign output_axis_tvalid = output_axis_tvalid_reg;
94: 
95: 
96: always @(posedge clk) begin
97:     if (rst) begin
98:         wr_ptr <= 0;
99:     end else if (write) begin
100:         if (full | full_cur | drop_frame) begin
101:             
102:             drop_frame <= 1;
103:             if (input_axis_tlast) begin
104:                 wr_ptr_cur <= wr_ptr;
105:                 drop_frame <= 0;
106:             end
107:         end else begin
108:             mem[wr_ptr_cur[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= data_in;
109:             wr_ptr_cur <= wr_ptr_cur + 1;
110:             if (input_axis_tlast) begin
111:                 if (input_axis_tuser) begin
112:                     
113:                     wr_ptr_cur <= wr_ptr;
114:                 end else begin
115:                     
116:                     wr_ptr <= wr_ptr_cur + 1;
117:                 end
118:             end
119:         end
120:     end
121: end
122: 
123: 
124: always @(posedge clk) begin
125:     if (rst) begin
126:         rd_ptr <= 0;
127:     end else if (read) begin
128:         data_out_reg <= mem[rd_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
129:         rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1;
130:     end
131: end
132: 
133: 
134: always @(posedge clk) begin
135:     if (rst) begin
136:         output_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b0;
137:     end else if (output_axis_tready | ~output_axis_tvalid_reg) begin
138:         output_axis_tvalid_reg <= ~empty;
139:     end else begin
140:         output_axis_tvalid_reg <= output_axis_tvalid_reg;
141:     end
142: end
143: 
144: endmodule
